data.notes: As of 2026-10-13, June 2027 Antwerp scene listings are still sparse; only confirmed non-arena scene events with public source pages are included.

events.title: Sunrise Festival 2027
events.summary: Sunrise Festival returns to De Lilse Bergen in Gierle from 24–27 June 2027. The official site describes a multi-stage summer festival with more than 200 artists across a broad range of genres.

events.title: Simply Red: Summer Funk ’27
events.summary: Simply Red bring their Summer Funk ’27 tour to AFAS Dome, with Mick Hucknall and the band billed for a soul-and-pop arena show on Tuesday 22 June 2027.

events.title: 10 jaar Bazart
events.summary: Belgian pop band Bazart celebrate their 10th anniversary with a De Roma concert-series stop on Sunday 20 June 2027; Live Nation lists Bazart as the main act.

events.title: Unicorn Festival 2027
events.summary: A three-day open-minded dance festival by the river with confirmed 2027 dates, multi-day timings, tickets on sale, and a TBA lineup.

events.title: Lambrini Girls
events.summary: Brighton punk duo Lambrini Girls play De Roma on their 2027 Belgian run, with the venue listing the show for Tuesday 1 June at 20:00.

events.title: OH HONEY
events.summary: Recurring queer underground house night at Club Traum, with the June 2027 edition confirmed and lineup/tickets still TBA.
